༄༅/ /grub thob shangs pa bka' rgyud kyi thabs lam gser gyi phung po zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grub thob shangs pa bka' rgyud kyi thabs lam

gser gyi phung po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ru bh+yeḥ rgyud sde lnga yi dkyil 'khor dang*/ /gnyis med khyung po rnal 'byor la/ /btud nas gang de'i man ngag gis/ /gsang ba cung zad bshad par bya/ /'dir bde ba lam byed kyi skor mkhas grub khyung po nas brgyud pa la da lta bka' ma chad pa 'di snyed cig yod de/ nai gu'i gzhan lus dang*/ su kha'i lugs dang*/ mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi dgongs 'dus dang*/ me tri ba'i/ a dwa ya badz+ra kyi man ngag ste lnga'o/ /dang po la/ gtum mo dang 'brel ba dang*/ sgyu lus dang 'brel ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ rang sems bde ba bsgom pa/ rlung gi lam sbyangs ba/ sbyor bya yum gyi mtshan nyid/ brten tshul dngos te bzhi las/ dang po ni/ chos drug gi rang lus/ thabs ldan gyi gtum mo lam khrid legs par sbyang ba zhig gis bsgom ste/ rang bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum du gsal bas lus kyi dbus su rtsa gsum gsal btab/ yas snar haṃ dang mas snar a yang gsal btab ste/ rlung bum can bzung*/ a dmar po cung zad zhu ba khro chu ltar tsha ba'i rak+ta'i 'khor lo bzhi mas rim gyi gang*/ haṃ zhu thig le dkar la bsil ba'i yas rim gyis gang*/ gnyis po 'gros 'ded lta bu la sems gtad/ thun 'jog khar dkar cha haṃ la stim/ dmar cha a la stim te dmigs pas nor bu'i nang du hūṃ sngon bo zhabs kyu phyir thon pa pad+ma'i lte bar su yig ser po/ de gnyis kyi zhabs kyu lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba/ yab kyi dbu ma thig le dkar po'i 'phreng ba dang*/ yum gyi dbu ma thig le dmar po'i phreng bas bstims pas/ snyoms par zhugs shing bskyod pa'i lhod tsam dang lto ba phyir phul tsam gyi bzung*/ de nas thur sel 'phul 'then dang*/ a a a zhes stod 'dren drag po dang*/ yang rngub ste rlung gi bgang 'dren drag po gnyis la lan gsum spel te 'dren/ bgang 'then drag po gnyis byas pa'i rang gi nor bu'i nang gi hūṃ bcas drang*/

rdo rje dang dbu ma sgyu ma zlog tu song*/ spyi bor thon par bsam/ skrug 'grems dang*/ 'bebs chung mang du byas te/ de la yang rlung bgang ba 'bud pa yang yang spel/ dmigs skor gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni bum pa can gnas bzhin pa'i skyil krung gyen thur/ seng ge 'gying snol/ 'gying bag bcu pa/ zla dpyad phrag sgang ltar 'gying ba/ glang bzhi gnang sor/ dgra ba'i mtha' ste/ 'khrul 'khor bcu'am/ bcu gnyis bya/ khyad par gser chos kyi 'khrul 'khor bzhi ni thogs la/ la la ring bar rngub lte 'og tu kha sbyor drag po bya/ de nas bgang 'dren 'dar thon pa dang*/ bgang gnon drag po 'phongs su srig gru bzhur drag po mnan/ de nas lto ba bcar te drag tu bus/ rgyu zhabs su stong gnon lan gsum nas nyer yang tsog pu'i ngang nas drag por rngub la mdun rgyab mnyam por rdeg /de nyid stod du sgril ba 'dar thon pa dang*/ de lan bdun spel/ de nas 'phongs btegs shing rdeb/ 'dom 'jal gi mthar gru mo rtsegs/ sgal tshigs srang*/ 'phongs stegs pus mo dgrad/ phyir bus de ka ba btsugs la gsang rtsa 'then/ yang drag tu rngub la steng mnan lan gsum dang*/ gyen du 'phar zhing 'og tu rdab pa lan gsum bzhi byas nas sbrag 'grem drag po bya ste/ 'dren 'grems so/ /yang tsog pu stod dkyil byas la/ pho bar kha sbyor drag po bya/ stod sgrim smad glod/ yang rlung smad du sdig /smad sgrim stod glod/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum bya/ lto ba ldir byas la rlung bus/ ma nang gi gru bzhud las/ gyen 'then dang*/ gyen du 'phar/ mthud gnon dang 'phong rdeb pa bstun lus sgrim zhing stang ba de 'dra lan lnga bya/ dbug shugs la 'ong du bcug nas/ lte 'og drag tu mnan la sprug pa dang*/ ha zhes stong sprug bya ste/ 'dzin 'dren 'grems pa dang dngas snyams 'byed pa bzhi char dus gcig 'byung ba ste gcig rdzogs so// //yang ha zhes rgya mtsho'i bcir la ka ba btsugs/

stod sgrim la stong 'dren dang*/ smad sgrim la stod gnon byas/ 'og sgo 'then/ de 'dra lan gsum nas gru bzhud las bgang 'dren bgang byon lan gsum dang*/ bgang sprug dang stong sprug bya/ lto ba bskyed pa'i bgang 'dren 'dar thon pa dang*/ bgang gnon gru bzhed drag po bung bskyed ba'i/ nad sogs 'og sgo nas thon par bsam te/ snyigs ma dang skyon 'don pa dag byed de rlung thim/ 'dren 'grems gcig rdzogs/ dag byed bzhi po 'di la/ tshogs 'khor re dang*/ gser gyi me tog gi bcad thang mdzad pa yin par gda' 'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sbyor bya yum gyi mtshan nyid de/ spyir bshad tshod mang yang 'dir de mi gtso'o/ /de la bu mo lo bcu drug nas sum cu so lnga tshun chad la bde ba 'phel nus/ lus dang bzhin mdzes pa/ skra bzang ba/ mkhur tshos la me tog yod pa/ kha dri zhim pa/ 'phongs zlum pa/ smad drod che zhing dam la yang dog ran pa dang*/ bde ba dang 'dod chags che ba/ nor yul phyogs zas gos dgra gnyen gyi zhen pa dang rnam rtog chung ba/ mang po'i dbus su spyod lam mdzangs zhing sngags kyi spyod pa'i skabs ngo tsha chung ba/ snying rje dang nges 'byung dang dad pa rnams rang bzhin gyi che na rab/ ma byung na yang gsos btab cing sgom tu bcug na skye ba'o/ /mtshan nyid gzhan rnams rnyed dka' zhing dgos pa chung gsung*/ /༈ bzhi pa la gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ yid du 'ong ba'i bu mo la sbyor bar bsam pa gsum pa'i skabs ltar bya ba ste/ yid kyi rig ma'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lag sor la sbyor ba ste/ lag pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dwangs snyigs 'byed pa las rtsa rnams dwangs snyigs dbye ba ste/ rtsa'i stong ra che chung byed pa la bslab pa dang*/ rlung dwangs snyigs dbye ba la gsum gyi dang po lte ba'i chos 'byung thig ler bcas pa la rlung thim par bsam shing*/ steng rlung thur du mnan/ g.yas lcog g.yon lcog sprug rdig rnams bya/

sor mo bskum la gru bzhur bya/༈ gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma ka ling 'dra snying ga'i thig le la thim par mos te/ rlung rngub ste 'og rlung dang sres/ 'phral du drag tu bus te stong 'dren gyi ngang nas g.yas lcog g.yon lcog sprug rdig bya'o/ /'di gnyis la tsog bu bya/༈ gsum pa bar rlung rgyang te lus stang ba'o/ /de dag phyag rgya la sbyor ba'i sngon du thun re zhing bya'o/ /thig le dwangs snyigs dbye ba ni/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la bslab pa spyi dang 'dra ste zhor la 'ong zhing gnad kyang chung gsungs/ de nas thog mar rang skyil krung gi pang du rig ma bzhag la lus yi dam yab yum mkha' gsang dang*/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dran tsam bya/ rdo rje pad+mar bcug te dar cig klod/ de nas dal bus bskyod cing*/ bde ba mgo g.yos pa la skyod 'phro bcad kyin bzung dgos te/ 'og sgo klod pa'i bzung stong 'dren bgang 'dren gru bzhud drag po rnams kyis drangs/ sprug 'grems re byas la 'khrul 'khor bzhi pa dang bcu pa dang*/ kha bub 'phongs klod rkyang skum rus sbal 'gros/ /rkang gshib lang 'dug lan gsum mthur gnon yin/ /nor bu bsdams te bgang 'then kha ching yin/ /so sprig sgra bcas 'bud skrug si sgra'o/ /zhes pa'i thim bzhir grags pa 'di yang bya ste/ 'di thog mar rang du legs so/ /de nas rim pa'i bslab pas/ thig le gsang bar 'dzin pa'i tshe zin dka' na sku gsum gyi thig bu steng nas brdab/ bya rog srog thums 'og nas brdab/ drug theb logs nas btab par bya/ zhes te dri aṅgu li dang brnying ba dang*/ srin por byang ba'i sbyor ba'o/ /de nas sems dwangs snyigs 'byed pa ni/ bde ba phyag rgya chen por ngo sprod pa'o/ /de dag ni gzhan lus kyi gtum mo'i gdams pa'o/ /༈gnyis pa ni/ sgyu lus sbas don zhes bya ste/ 'di la rlung sbyang ba bum pa can kho na dang gzhan snga ma dang 'dra bas/

'dir 'khrul 'khor dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ dbab pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam gsum ni/ rdo rje'i skyil krung lan gsum 'deg /rdo rje khu tshur thur du mnan/ /bya snyong bya zhing lan gsum rdig /bzung ba'i 'khrul 'khor rnam gsum ni/ /lus gnad mnyam bzhag sa gnon la/ /rlung gnad bla ma'i zhal las shes/ /zlog pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam gsum ni/ /lus gnad rus sbal kha bub la/ /hūṃ gnyis re mos bshang lam zlog /'gram pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam gsum ni/ /gcan zan rgyal po'i ste sprug steng dang*/ /spyang mo sdug dang rgod ldang bya/ /mi chen 'dug kyang gnon par bzhed/ /dang po ni/ rdor dkyil lag gnyis dpyi thad par btsugs rdeb/ gnyis pa ni/ sems dkyil pus mor khu tshur gan rkyal nas/ rlung bzung tshur drangs brla yi rtsa bar mnan/ gsum pa ni/ khur tshur rlar bzhag pus btsugs 'phar rdeb bya/ 'then gnon dang sbyor zhing de gsum la mgo bkug /mig gyen du zlog /lce rkan la sbyar/ dmigs pa haṃ la gtad do/ /bzhi/ lnga/ drug pa gsum ni/ sems dkyil steng mnan 'og rlung rang sa la/ /g.yas gcu g.yon pa mnyam bzhag g.yas sa gnon/ /de nyid go bzlog dbu la gnyis sa gnon/ /lte bar sems btod mig sogs gong dang 'dra/ /bdun/ brgyad/ dgu pa gsum ni/ rkang ngar lag ngar sar btsug lus rgur la/ /lag sor snol la mgo dgur hūṃ rangs bus/ /mgod gyed rngub nas hūṃ thung bgang 'then dang*/ /bshang lam gyen zlog bgang stong 'dren gnyis so/ /bcu pa ni/ rkang lag sor mo sar btsug sder bzhi bsgrad/ /g.yas g.yon dbus su lcog cing sprug pa'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ khu tshur bcing te sug bzhi 'dzug pa sogs gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /de gnyis la rjes 'phongs rdeb cing rlung 'bud cing sprug 'grems bya'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni langs te rkang sgrad lags pa sked gzer bya/ /dpung pa g.yas g.yon lcag byas mdun du 'phar/ /sgyid pa sdem byas rlung btang sprug sprug pa'o/

/bcu gsum byed na spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa ni gzhan dang 'dra ba las rang dang rig ma phyag rgya snang stong sgyu mar shes pa dang*/ lha sku gsal stong du rgyas thebs bzhin pa'i/ gzugs mdzes pa lta ba me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang stong dang*/ 'khrig tshig dang dga' ba'i sgra sogs brag cha ltar grag stong dang*/ 'khyud pa dang rdo rje pad+mar reg pa sogs kyi bde ba myongs yang 'di yin bzung du med pa/ sems bde stong dang*/ rdo rje pad+mar skyod pa'i bde gsal mi rtog pa ngos bzung du med pa blos dpyad du med pa/ tshig gis brjod du med pa sgyu ma sgyu 'dzin dang bral ba la snyoms par bya'o/ /'dir rtsol ba rab gtum mo rang lus la 'bad pa rnams gzhan lus sgom dus lam gyi rkang tshugs pa'i dbang du byas nas/ gzhan lus gtum mor rgyas par bstan pa yin/ kha cig gtum mo mi lcog par sgyu lus man chad sgom pa'i so so'i dge sbyor bzang rab byung ba la/ rlung phyogs bsdus tsam bstan nas gzhan lus kyi nyin par dang*/ rmi lam dang 'od gsal gsum la bogs 'byin pa ni sgyu lus sbas don gyi go ba ste/ chags lam rgyas bsdus gnyis khrid kyi gzhung shing gcig la yod pas rgyu mtshan de yin no/ /'di ni slob dpon a yi seng ge dang*/ gser gling pa bkra shis dpal gyi yig chung las zhal gdams snyan rgyun gyis rgyan pa ltar bkod pa yin la/ shing ston chen po'i yig chung yang don 'di kar 'dug phyis su ro snyoms rdo rjes zin bris la ni/ lhad che zhing lhag chad gnyis ka yod do/ /'di lag len khrigs chags su gsal bar bkod pa'o/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro nai gu ma'i gsang lam bshad zin to/ /༈ gnyis pa mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi ri bong dbab bzung la ni/ don gsum ste/ rig ma brtag cing dgug pa/ sta gon sbyang ba/ las la sbyar ba 'phros dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dkar mo dpral bar sme pa yod pa bud+dha'i rigs/

dmar mo lte bar sme ba yod pa dpral bar rtse gsum yod pa rin chen rigs/ dkar la dmar ba mgrin par sme ba can skyes pa'i reg na mi bzod pa pad+ma'i rigs/ sngo sangs nu phrag dog pa rna ba g.yon pa la sme ba can las kyi rigs/ sngo sangs snying kha la sme ba can thugs kyi rigs yin no/ /zhes su kha sid+dhi gsungs so/ /dung can ma gnas lnga po gang rung du dung 'dra ba'i ri mo yod pa/ glang chen ma der sme ba smug po yod pa/ pad+ma can la thig le'i ri mo yod pa/ ri dwags can ma la ri mo dgu po rgyab sprod du yod pa/ ri mo can ma la ri mo drang po gsum/ lcug phran ma la lnga/ chos 'byung ma la gru gsum 'byung ba'o/ /de dag la bde ba myur ba dang*/ stong nyams che ba dang*/ bde ba rgyas pa dang*/ bde ba 'bring dang*/ thig le 'dzin sla ba dang*/ gsal nyams che ba dang*/ bde ba shugs che ba rnams kyi dgos pa yod do/ /zhes gang ga dhā ra gsungs so/ /yang kha'i mchu las bha ga brtag /mchu mthug na bha ga sha rgyas/ kha che chung la bha ga che chung yod/ bha ga lo dgu la sor lnga/ bcu drug la khyud gang*/ nyi shu la sor bcu gnyis che tshad yin te/ de las dkyus ring ba ni mi brten no/ /bde ba che chung mig la brtag ste/ mig dkyus ring shing mig 'bras nag ba sri ga dang*/ mig 'dzum yod na bzang*/ skra dang nu ma legs na bdag po la gus te/ skra li na rab/ ser na 'bring*/ nag po rkyang pa tha ma'o/ /nu ma 'bur shing zlum pa rab/ rno ba 'bring*/ 'phyang ba tha ma'o/ /ol mdud dang snying spu 'dug na gsang thub par yod/ bha ga yang spu med pa dang*/ spu nag po mthug po dang*/ ser kham gsum rab 'bring tha ma'o/ /bha ga phyi dkar nang dmar ba dang smug pa dang*/ sngo ba rnams spyir sha mdog dkar ba gzhir bzhag pa la rab 'bring tha ma ste/ lce dang snying las bha ga'i kha dog dang*/ mchan khung gi spu las de'i spu brtag dgos te/ de dang de dag mtshungs par 'ong ngo*/

/zhes kun du bzang mos gsungs so/ /dgug pa ni bu mo de'i chu rdul gyi sa la gzugs brnyan bya/ snying gar gi haṃ dang pad+ma rak+ta'i ming rus bris pa'i shog dril gzhug /dgug gzhug bya/ zangs kyi ling ga'i khab kyi bha ga 'tshag cing*/ a ha ra ni sa/ ch+gai mo/ khug rnam shes brang brang dung dung bdag gi dbang du bsdus a ha ri ni sa/ zhes zhag bdun bzlas/ sngags de bzlas pa'i bza' btung byin na dbang du 'dus so/ /yang mkha' 'gro su kha sid+dhis gnyan ston la dngos su gnang ba'i dgug pa zab mo ni/ rdzas sbal pa'i nang du ming rus bris la gzhug yungs dkar bdun nang du gzhug bdun sbal pa'i khog tu bcug /rang phag mo'i thugs ka nas pho nya mo dmar mo mang po spros khams gsum dbang du bsdus par bsam la ngag bcad de/ swahā bhas sha khol tsag tsag dung dung 'dur yed yed ch+gai mo/ /tsit+ta dkrug bdag gi dbang du gyur cig /ces sems ma yengs par rab zhag gcig /'bring gnyis/ tha ma gsum na rmi lam du bud med 'du ba/ khrom 'tshogs pa/ gter rnyed pa sogs 'byung ngo*/ /las sbyor ni nyi ma dmar thag chod ba na rdzas la sngags stong tsam zlas/ rab phyes nyung dkar gtor ba/ 'bring sha la slan pa tsam dang*/ tha ma'ang sbal bas lus la theb na the tshom med/ lus 'khyor ba dang*/ sems mi gnas pa yong nyen yod/ de la 'dod pa spyad pas sel/ dgrol bar 'dod na/ gangs chu grang mo lus la rgyab/ sngags mgo mjug zlog /sbal ba bcag ming rus spos chus khrus byas pas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rtsa 'tshol ba ni/ spyi bor/ gla rtsi/ tsan+dan dkar po/ til dmar gsum sres pa'i mnye/ sga shing steng du mkhal snol dang shing leb dang*/ ske rags bsdam/ bshang lam du 'be lto 'phyang bu bcug pa'i/ bha ga'i mkhur sha nu ma 'dra bar 'gro/ rtsa'i rtse mo rib rib 'ong*/ yang na bcos ma'i rdo rje'i phyi nas cig nang du skor ba'i rtsa yod par 'phrad pa la 'khun zhing sngangs yod pa 'ong*/

rtsa sbom na pad+ma dkar po'i rtsa ba dgos te/ bod du mi rnyed pa'i ug chos me tog rtsa ba dang bcas pa ba dkar mo'i 'o ma/ ka ra/ mar gsar/ gang sba lam/ da byid smug po'i tshil sbyar ba byug pa'am/ chang dang sbyar ba pad+mar blug pa'i phra bar 'gyur ro/ /rgya tshos kyi khu ba chu rtsa'i me la skol/ spang rgyan me tog btab pa btung pa dang*/ gnyer po cher gser gyi me rtsa byed pa/ bha ga chu lcag dang*/ 'phongs tshos la ber ka'i dal bur rdung ba sogs ni srid rgyun skem pa'o/ /gnyis pa bum pa can la brtan po sgom pa yin na/ 'khrul 'khor rnams las la sbyar ba'i skabs su dgos na'ang*/ da lta nas sbyang dgos pas thams cad la rlung khrab sngon du gtong ba shes par bya'o/ /'dzin pa la gsum gyi/ dang po klod pa ni/ lus sems khong klod/ srin zhal phan pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgya mtsho bcer ba sogs 'gyur ba bzhi'o/ /gsum pa sems kyi 'khrul 'khor te bde ba'i ngo bo la ltas nas klod pa'o/ /bzlog pa lnga'i dang po ni/ spyir rdo rje thal mo 'then la stong 'dren byas la sems nam mkha' 'phang langs te lan gsum skyed cing stod 'dren byed/ gnyis pa ni/ pus btsug rdo rje khu tshur mdun du bcug la hag hig hog ces/ snying ga/ mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su drang ngo*/ / gsum pa ni/ rtsal sprug gi mthar/ steng rlung phyir 'phang thur sel mthen/ skyil krung rdo rje khu tshur brla rgang la bcug ste rgang 'dren bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sems dkyil stod skyil yang bcas nas smad kyi rlung khong 'dren dang stong 'dren bya'o/ / lnga pa ni/ lag pa g.yon rkyang g.yas dpung bar khu tshur bcing*/ rkang pa rta la g.yon zhon byed tshul gyi g.yon nas rgang 'then bya/ de nyid go bzlog re'ang bya'o/ /dgrams pa la dgu las/ dang po ni/ langs te slar bsdad thal mo rtsegs/ lag pa brkyang mgo bo la thal lcags re mos su rdeg pa dang 'phags cing lag pa'ang sprug go

/gnyis pa ni/ dgur la rkang lag re mos su 'khrab bo/ /gsum pa ni/ dkyil krung lag gnyis dpung 'dzin pho khar snol/ bzhi sprug byas nas mchan khung rdeb cing 'phags pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje skyil krung dang rdo rje khu tshur mkhal ma'i thad du btsug la pho ba skor/ gsang ba lcog cing g.yas 'then g.yon 'then bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ lang la lag gnyis sprug drug pa ni/ cung zad rgan rkyal sug bzhi phu ba'o/ /bdun pa ni/ sug bzhi btsug la g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du bteg cing 'then no/ /brgyad pa ni/ gdung sna sogs la 'jug te brkyang skum bya'o/ /dgu pa ni/ gan rkyal dang kha bub rung sug bzhi phyogs bzhir brkyang nas bcud la bor ro/ /de dag las 'dren kun la smad sgrim stod klod rgya mtsho bcer ba sogs gang 'grub dgos/ 'grems kun la kha sbyor lus lhod cing 'chun dang ldan pa dgos/ kun khyab tu seng ge rnam rol yang bya'o/ /de dag la sdom 'di skad ces bya ste/ /klod dang 'gyur bzhi gzhom pa ste/ /'dzin pa rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /rdo rje thal mo khu tshur pus btsug dang*/ /rtsal sprug khong 'dren rta zhon tshul/ /'dren pas 'khrul 'khor rnam lnga'o/ /dgram pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam dgu ni/ /dang po mgo lcog 'phar sprug bya/ /gnyis pa rkang lag re mos 'khrab/ /gsum pa dpung 'dzin bzhi sprug rdeb/ /bzhi pa mkha' mnan pho ba skor/ /lnga drug lag sprug gan rkyal 'khrab/ / bdun pa sug bzhi g.yas g.yon 'then/ /brgyad dgu brkyang skum gan rkyal rgyangs/ /'di dag mkha' 'gro gsum gyi man ngag gung spros pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ dbab bzung zlog dgram rlung dang bsre ba/ ye shes chen por sre ba'o/ / de dag kyang su kha sid+dhi 'dod yon lnga la rim slob mi bzhed/ gaṅga rda ras/ ro la bslab pa nas reg bya spyi dang rdo rje pad+mar reg pa yan chad sdom pa la thun gcig tu mdzad pa yin/ kun du bzang mo ni/

glu snyan pa dang*/ gzugs la lta ba dang*/ ku re byed pa dang*/ lus kyi rtsed mo dang*/ lag bcing dang*/ 'o dang*/ 'khyud dang so dang sen mos 'debs pa dang*/ bde reg byed pa dang*/ phyi rol drud pa ste drug /phyis reg bya la bslab pa dang*/ snyoms par 'jug pa ste/ chags spyod bdun du bzhed do/ /de la rdo rje pad+mar cung zad gsor zhing*/ nor bu hūṃ nag po mgo gyen bstan gyis bkag par bsam/ 'dzin pa'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis pa'i 'dzin pa yin/ zin dka' na hūṃ gi phul nas thig le ba thag lta bu spyi bor lhan lhan thim par bsam la/ hūṃ 'dren drag tu bya'o/ /de nas lus kun sprug cing glang bzhi 'phang ba dang brkyang bskum bya'o/ /yang dang por dal bu dang mthar drag tu srub pa'i rang dang rig ma gny-is ka'i thig le zhu bar byas/ de nas mi srub par rgya mtsho sbyar te hūṃ 'dren drag po byas la bu mo 'od du zhu nas rdo rjes drangs te rang lus khyab pa'i mdangs rgyas par mos/ de'i shes rab mas pad+mar grags sing ba dang khyur khyur drang ba'i nyams dang*/ bde ba zug dang bcas pa mi bzod pa byung na 'dren thub pa'i rtags so/ /su kha'i lugs so/ /yang sha chen dug phyung ba ba dmar mo'i 'o mar btsos/ shing kun dang kha ru tshwa btab pa bsten mchil pa'i sha dang*/ da byid kyang btang*/ lug sha dang*/ chang 'jam po zung te brten/ ra mo sha'i khan+da dang*/ zho ma skrog pa bza' ba'i bdag dang rig ma gnyis ka'i lus zung skyed/ rtsa ring na rkang pa brkyang*/ thung na rig ma'i rkang pa 'phrag par bkal nas skal la spyod/ pad+ma'i nang gi g.yas g.yon steng 'og tu rdo rjes drud pa'i rtsa btsal/ rig ma'i kyang 'og rlung bskum steng rlung gnon pa'i rtsa ster bar bya/ thig le 'byung ba snyam byed na 'phongs bsgrad/ mig gyen du blta/ shes rab ma'i sked pa nyags btang la rlung gsang gnas su phul bas zin yod la/ de nas drang*/ yang bde ba yal du mi 'jug par bskyod cing 'beb/

'phongs bde ba'i sgrad nas 'byed mi thub na/ lag pas dbye'o/ /gaṅga rda ra'i lugs so/ /phal cher de dang 'dra ba la mig gyen du gtad/ pus mo la lag pa bkab/ hūṃ ring gi mthar hig gi 'dren yun ring sbyangs nas/ lcam pa'i rkang 'jam po rdo rje'i bu gar cung zad 'jug cing mthar rtsa bar lhan gyi gtong ngo*/ /de nas de 'dren pa la bslab/ de nas mdun mnan te 'phongs 'byed 'dzum gyi dbyung ba la bslab/ de nas dngos gzhi la 'jug /'dzin pa la sems kyi thim bu ste 'khrul 'khor gsum pa dang rting bas dra ba dang*/ brdegs pa'i gnon pa kho na yin no/ /kun tu bzang mo'i lugs so/ /de nas thams cad la yang rus sbal 'gros kyis phab/ so so'i man ngag gis phyag rgya la sbyor bzhin pa'i ngang nas bzung klog gang 'grub bya/ de nas 'dren lnga dang 'grem dgu po de rnams ci rigs pa bya/ thams cad la seng ge rnam rol gang mang bya ste/ zlog pa dang khyab par bya'o/ /de nas bum pa can gang mang bsgom te rlung dang bsre'o/ /ye shes chen por skyel ba ni sgyu lus sbas don dang 'dra'o/ /ma rgyud spyi'i rdzogs rim mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi gsang lam bshad zin to/ /'di la gzhung shing yig rnying kho na las phyis yi ge gsar pa'i bsre slad med cing*/ phyis kyi yi ge 'khrul 'khor nyi shu pa dang nyer gcig zer ba gnyis gda' na'ang*/ gzhan nas rkus shing khungs med la/ phyi ma rnams 'di yang nai gu'i gsang khrid yin zer ba ches 'khrul lo/ /'di la yig rnying yig chung drug yod do/ /a+thi+-i/ shubhaṃ/ /༈gsum pa ni mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i las rgyas man ngag ni/ bde ba bzung ba dang*/ bde ba skyed pa dang*/ bde ba sbyang ba dang*/ bde ba gnas pa'i thabs so/ /dang po ni/ gtum mo dang phyag chen la gom par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa la mthar skyes kyi grong du zhugs te mtshan ldan gyi rig ma btsal ba dang*/ 'gyur ba bco lnga'i rlung la rab tu gom pa dang*/

sbyor ba la mkhas pa'i rab tu gom pa dang*/ sku bzhi'i bde ba skyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rigs dang mthun pa dang*/ rtsa dang ldan pa dman pa'i rig ma'o/ /dang po ni/ dkar sham mo rdo rje'i rigs/ ser skya mo rin chen rigs/ dmar smug mo pad+ma'i rigs/ sme ba can ma las kyi rigs/ sngo sangs ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dung can ma rtsa rtsegs pa'i rtse mo lta bu/ pad+ma can mkhal ma bzhib pa lta bu/ glang sna can thung zhing gug pa/ li ri can thag bcus kyi rtse mo lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs gsum spang*/ dmangs rigs nga rgyal chung ba'i shes pa'i yul du phan 'dogs che ba'o/ /gnyis pa 'gyur ba bco lnga ni/ 'dug stangs lnga/ skad lnga/ dmigs pa btod pa lnga'o/ /de dag la 'dug stang dang skad dang dmigs pa re re sbrags te sgom dgos pa'i/ dang po ni/ gcer bu'i 'dug stangs*/ tsog bur 'dug nas lag pa brang la snol/ sgra glang chen haṃ skad kyis 'dren/ dmigs pa lte bar btod/ dang po'o/ /gyad stobs po che'i 'dug stangs/ rkang pa'i rting pa 'og sgor gtad lag pa dang pus mo sa la btsugs/ seng ge'i ngur skad khyung khyung phaṭa kyis sgras drangs/ sems snying khar btod/ gnyis so/ /drang srong bstan ma'i 'dug stangs/ rdor dkyil lag mgo 'phongs tshos kyis mnan hig 'dren/ mgrin par sems gtod gsum pa'o/ /rigs ngan gyi 'dug stangs/ tsog bu pus 'khyud dang*/ gcan gzan snom skad sna nas 'bud/ smin mtshams su sems btod bzhi pa'o/ /sgegs po 'gyur ba'i 'dug stangs langs te yang rkang ngar sa la btsug khu tshur mchan khung du bcug /wa skad 'don pa lta bu wa mo'i bzhad sgra kha nas 'don/ spyi bor sems gtod do/ /gsum pa sbyor ba la mkhas pa las/ gdan

: dings [ gding ] pa ni dngul lam gsha' tshe'i rigs kyi snod phug ron gyi sgong nga tsam sgong gzugs ma kha dang ldan pa/ khab shul tsam gyi bu ga mang po nang du cung za'i phye hros dang ba'i 'o skol blug pa'i rnam lnga'i kha bcad de la'ang khab shul gsum btod/ thag pa btag de sked pa la gdag la de nyid 'phongs su chud tsam bya'o/ /sku 'dren pa ni bal gyi bgang rdur gyi 'be lto phyag rgya'i skur bcug /chus 'chang ba'i bcing ba ni nu ma dang mchan khung bsdam pa'o/ /rgyab yol bre ba ni/ ras 'bol dkyus la mtho do zheng du mtho gang yod pa sked pa'i 'og tu 'jug pa'o/ gdugs 'bug pa ni ras de tsam zhig 'jing 'og tu 'jug pa'o/ /rtsa gso ba na rig ma la 'jam bshal btang*/ de rjes ba'i 'o ma sum cha tsam skams skams su bskol bar byas la/ gur gum a kar nag po/ li shi gsum btags la btab de btang*/ ra sha chu ser bton pa sogs tshad brten du 'jug go /de ni rgya gar gyi dbang du byas pa ste/ bod yul gyi zas spyod dang bstun dgos so/ /rtsa blang ba ni bur dkar dang bdud rtsi sres la snyug sbugs bkang*/ rtse mo rtsa la rags tshod btang te bha gar blugs pa'o/ /rtsa mthu skyed pa ni chags spyod sna tshogs kyi g.ya' blang ba'i 'khrang por byed pa chang gar ma/ phul gang tsam blang ba'i ngo bzi tsam byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa rgyu bzhi'i bde ba skyed pa ni/ rtsa dang sprad pa te dung can ma yin na rdo rje pad+ma'i gting phyin par 'bur/ pad+ma can ma la bshang lam phyogs nas rdar te pad+mar bcug /pad+ma'i nang rdo rje krug nas gting las sor gnyis tsam tshur 'then pa btsal/ dung can ma la rgyab 'phong phyogs la bzhar nas bcug /li ri can la steng te bya lce'i 'og tu drud do/ /des rtsa dang 'phrad 'ong*/ spyir rigs bco lnga yod kyang rtsa spro ba bzhi las med gsung*/ gsum pa bde ba sbyang ba gsum ste/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob dang*/

shes pa gsal btab pa'o/ /dang po la dbab pa dang zlog pa dang*/ dkyil ba dang*/ spar pa ba'o/ /dang po la ting nge 'dzin dang*/ 'dug stangs dang*/ rdo rje cung zad skyod pa'i dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni bha ga'i nang gi dbus nas 'od dmar po byung*/ nor bur zhugs dbu ma'i lam rgyud spyi gtsug gi thig le zhu gsang ba'i bar du phyin par bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ shes rab ma la lhag por ras 'bol dpangs sor bzhi rgya mtho gang btang*/ bu mo'i rkang pa thabs kyis brla steng nas btang rgyab tu 'khyud ldem bya/ dpa' bo rkang bapa dgra med bskyang ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rus sbal 'gros so/ /gnyis pa zlog pa ni gsum ste/ rlung dmigs kyi zlog /lus cha sgrims pa'i zlog /rig ma'i rlung gi zlog go /dang po ni 'gyur ba bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa la go bar zad la/ gsum pa ni/ rig ma'i rlung gsang bar sdig pa'o/ /rtsa rnyed na hūṃ dgur 'gyur lan drug gis mar cha drang la dkyil ba dang gnas thabs bya'o/ /gsum pa dkyil ba ni 'gyur ba bco lnga'i sgra skad rnam gsum btud pa'o/ /bzhi pa/ spar ba ni ro rtsa ba'i kha zas bza'/ bud med mdzes ma la lta ba dang*/ rgod pa dang*/ 'khyud pa dang*/ 'khrigs thabs byed pa la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa rjes thob ni dpa' bo'i yul gyi zhen pa zlog la sgom pa bya ba/ 'dod yon bzang po la ma chags par rol ba'o/ /chags pa'i yid kyi lta ba'i sgom bya ba/ bud med thams cad la 'dod chags skyes te dbyings su bsre ba'o/ /snang ba thug phrad du sgom pa bya ba thams cad la bde bas 'debs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mnyam rjes khyad med par stong pa dang bde bas rgyas btab pa'o/ /bzhi pa/ bde ba gnas pa'i thabs ni/ bum can dang phyag chen dang rnam rol bsre ba'o/ /yang yig rnying gcig na sbyang ba dang*/ dkyil ba la bcas pa lus kyi gnad dmigs pa'i gnad rlung gi gnad de gsum tshang dgos zhes pa yod de/ 'gyur lnga gsum bco lnga nyid do/

/dgyes mdzad/ 'dus pa/ bde mchog gsum gyi man ngag mnga' bdag mai tri ba'i gsang lam bshad zin to/ /dge'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ mai tri ba'i slob ma'ang yin mod/ gdam ngag gzhan mang pos thugs rgyud 'chug pa mi mnyam rdo rje'i khol po zhes pa'am/ a tu la dwa sa badz+ra gyi chags lam 'di la mnyam par sbyor ba'i yul dang*/ snyoms 'jug dngos so/ /dang po ni/ gzhan brtag thabs spyi dang mthun/ pad+ma brgya byin gyi mig 'dra ba rdo rje'i rigs/ shin du yang ba rin chen rigs 'di gnyis rlan cher 'bab pa'o/ /ran zhing drod che ba rnam snang gi rigs/ shin du dam pa pad+ma'i rigs/ pad+ma chags pa'i rlung gi sgra 'byung ba las kyis rigs so/ /rim pa'i bya lce yang khro bo'i sna ltar rtog por 'gril ba dang*/ srab cing che ba dang*/ srab cing chung ba dang*/ sdigs mdzub ltar sgreng ba dang*/ sna rtse ltar rno ba'o/ /yang rim pa ltar rnam 'gyur gyi dbang du byas na/ rig ma'i thabs la 'o 'khyud so sen 'debs sogs rang shugs su 'chor ba dang*/ spyod lam btang snyoms su 'dug pa dang*/ gzhan mi 'byung bar dam du 'khyud cing yar 'degs kyi sgul skyod sna tshogs byed pa dang*/ reg pa mi bzod cing*/ pad+ma 'dzum sdeb 'byung la rgod pa dang*/ sngangs shing mkhun che chung 'don la gtam tshig mi go bar smra ba rnams so/ /gnyis pa la/ dbab/ dkyil/ zlog drangs gnas su skyal lus la dgram yan lag la spro ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rig ma la dal bu'i srub cing*/ sbyor ba dang rig ma la mi bsam/ shes pa dbyings su gtad la yengs su gzhug /gnyis pa ni/ des thig le rdo rje'i rtsa bar bab/ bde ba rgyas/ thig le 'chor tshad pa la ma shor ba'i skabs der/ mig gyen la zlog /'og sgo sdams/ rgya mtsho bcir/ nya bzhi sgrim lag pa'i sor mo gsum 'jib/ dbugs rngub ste bsdams rlung sems snying khar bsdus la bzhag /'di skabs skyod 'phro bcad la rdo rje pad+ma g.yo 'gul med par bzhag

/de 'dra dbugs thengs gsum btud la bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas kyang rdo rje pad+ma ma phral ba nyid du sbyor ba drug pa gzhan dang 'dra ba la/ hal zhes pa'i hi ri ri zhes 'dren/ de'i bde ba yal la khad song ba na/ yang dbab skyil zlog pa sogs gong bzhin sbyang*/ de ltar lan gsum bzhi bya/ bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje pad+ma phral te/ de 'phral sbyor ba drug pa hūṃ sgra dwangs ba'i lan gsum brgyud mar drag tu drangs/ dmigs pa rtsa dbu ma rnyog spu tsam gyi nang na yar thig le skya chil li li song*/ spyi bo'i haṃ la sib sib thim par bsam mo/ /'di skabs hūṃ dang hig dang ṇir sogs rang gang mos yin la/ thams cad byas kyang yong*/ de gsum kar sna nas 'bud pa gtso che gsung ngo*/ /hūṃ la nges par kha sdam par bya'o/ /lnga pa ni lnga ste/ dang po thig le sgra can dang 'dra ba la aṃ zhes drangs pas/ gsang ba nas lte bar sleb par bsam/ /༈ gnyis pa tsog pu pus brang sbyar/ lag sor gru mor 'jus/ lag ngar pus mor 'khyud la sgom thag gi phyag rgya bcas/ rlung nang du drangs/ 'og 'then pa dang gre bar ngur ngur gyi sgra lte ba nas snying khar sleb par bsam/ gsum pa dkyil krung rdo rje khu tshur lte khung gnyis su btsug /stod sgur la hag hag ces drangs pa'i snying ka nas mgrin par sleb par bsam/ bzhi pa skyil krung rdo rje thal mo kha bub rla g.yas g.yon gyi steng nas gnon zhing 'dren pas hi hig ces mgrin pa nas spyi bor sleb par bsam/ lnga pa dkyil krung lus srang rdo rje khu tshur mchan khung g.yas g.yon du bcug /dbugs rngub pa sgra gdangs 'og rlung 'then brang skyed mgrin pa dgug pa'i spy-i bo nas gtsug tor tu drangs bar bsam mo/ / ༈ drug pa ni/ seng ge rnam rol/ ༈ bdun pa ni/ lang la mgo dang rkang lag lan gsum sprug ldan nas kyang de bzhin dang*/ gan rkyal las kyang de bzhin bya'o/ /las rgya'i gdams ngag bod du 'gyur ba gcig la 'di las zab pa med ces grags la grub thob zhing chos sang nas brgyud pa yin no/

/grub chen mi mnyam rdo rje'i man ngag las rgya'i sbyor ba bshad zin to/ /ka l+yā ṇa bi su li/ ༈ lnga pa ni/ slob dpon ra hu la las rlung la bum pa can dang rlung 'khor lo bcing grol dang*/ phyag rgya 'ching grol zhes pa rnams rang lus kyi gdams pa kho na yin pas/ 'dir mi 'chad la/ 'dir shing rta can bshad par bya'o/ /'di rlung bzung ba dang*/ sgom pa dang*/ bogs dbyung ba gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ dben par dkon mchog mchod pa dang*/ smon lam btab/ bdud rtsi lnga'i chu tshan dang*/ ba'i 'o ma skol bas ba byung lnga dang bza' ba bdud rtsi lnga sres ba'i khrus bya/ a ru ra/ 'o mar btsos pa mur ci bder 'dug pa zhag lnga'am/ bdun bya/ khri'u khru do ba brnyan po gnyis gzhu snyi ba gnyis chang bzung mar bstan la g.yas g.yon du bcing*/ dbus kyi steng du shing gcig gnyis gsum gang 'os btang la bcing*/ rje btsun ma dang mgon po gtso bor gyur pa dang mkha' 'gro lnga la gtor ma bzang du phul/ tshogs mchod rgyas par bya/ nang gtor ma bsdus pas skabs su slob ma shing rta la skyon/ rkang pa'i phrang ba'i gzhu'i chang zung nam tsam bya/ lag gnyis thal mo spyi bor sbyar la rkyang*/ lus khong stong gi dkyil gyi dbu ma nas sems thig le 'u ru ru thon tshangs bug rgyud/ mkha' dbyings mthon por thig le la sems gtad/ rkang pa brkyang te 'og sgo bsdam du bcug /bla ma dang grogs kyi rol mo'i sgra bya/ gu gul bdug /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la gsol ba drag tu btab/ yang yang gzhu rgyud skul lo/ /de 'dra lan mang du byas pas 'og gi rlung zin par 'gyur ro/ /yang tsog pu bya rog 'dug stangs la/ rkang mtheb la gzhu rgyud rig ge bya/ rlung gi 'degs par bsam/ 'og rlung sdams/ rol mo sogs gong bzhin bya'o/ /'dis steng rlung zin par 'gyur ro/ /de yang rlung tshes gcig gi snga dro/ me rlung gnam stong gi srod/ cha mnyam nyer gnyis kyi nyin phyed la/

rlung chen po tshes brgyad tho rangs 'dzin te/ tsha shas che ba dang*/ grang shas che ba dang*/ bad kan can dang*/ rlung lhag par che ba rnams la rim pas shes so/ /'di skabs 'phar g.yo brgyal ba sogs byung na rlung zin zhing tshud pa yin la/ bla ma'i grogs kyi rtag tu lta ba gal che'o/ /thal nyen byung na sbyor ba klod/ thun mtshams su dbu ma'i nang smin mtshams su haṃ dkar po/ rdo rje'i rtser aṃ dmar po/ rlung kha sbyor drag po sgom/ bde shas che na 'og klod stong shas che na steng klod/ mnyam na zung du 'jug par mnan no/ /dhu tir shes pa yar 'gro mar 'gro byas la lta res bya'o/ /'phar g.yo ku co rgyal ba sogs/ ches na rlung gi dug dbyung ba bya sna rtser khab tsag byas khrag dbyung ba sogs bya'o/ /spyi gtsug dang snying kar bdud rtsi lnga dang mi tshil byug lus g.yer ma dang sran phye'i mnyes/ chu skol la tang 'khun pa'i phye ba btab pa btung pa'i khyab byed log pa sel/ 'bru mar dang g.yer ma tshigs par byug la/ rkang 'og gi yaṃ la sems gtad/ de dag gi snyo pa dang*/ khyab byed log pa dang*/ sha lpags bar du zhugs pa dang*/ rtsub mo'i sbyor ba zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la/ sbyang ba/ spel ba/ dbang du bya'o/ /dang po/ dbugs 'greng ba la dmigs skor gcig gsang 'dus dang mthun pa'i rdor bzlas la dmigs skor gcig steng rlung 'og rlung 'then pa la dmigs skor re re/ kha sbyor gnon pa la dmigs skor gcig rtsa gsum lte bar srad bu ltar dpyang pa la g.yas su e dmar g.yon du waṃ dkar babs 'og rlung 'then pas e waṃ dbu mar zhugs/ spyi gtsug tu drangs so lus bde ba dang*/ yang ba dang*/ zo mdog pa de ba 'byung ngo*/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyor ba'i don dang*/ yi ge'i don dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi don dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag stai bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sems can thams cad sems dpa' sum brtseg tu ye nas gnas/

rang sems 'od dkar po sran rdog tsam 'og sgo nas dhu ti nang la 'u ru ru thon/ nyi zla thug par 'phong*/ nam mkha' ltar rgya skyed pa ste/ sems can thams cad kyi sems mkha' khyab la sems gtad/ rlung gtong ba'i tshe mar bab ste 'og sgor sleb par bsam mo/ / gnyis pa ni/ lte ba nas 'bru gsum sbor ba ste gzhan de dang 'dra/ gsum pa ni/ lte ba nas rim pa'i stong par gtong ba la sems gtod tshul gyi spro bsdu gong dang 'dra/ bzhi pa ni/ don dam pa'i lha sngags gnyug ma'i gnas lugs la mnyam par bzhag pa'o/ /bzhi ka la thun 'jig khar sems can thams cad sems dpa' sum brtseg tu gsal bas hūṃ gi mthar sngags kyi skor bar bsgom mo/ / thams cad la mda' ltar 'phang ba dang*/ nam mkha' ltar rgya skyed pa 'dra'o/ / gsum pa dbang du bya ba ni/ lte bar 'khor lo drag tu skor zhing rgya skyed pa dang*/ gser gyi 'khor lo 'og sgo nas dhu tir brgyud spyi bo nas mthon mkha' dbyings mthon por 'gro zhing slar 'ong bar sgom/ gsum pa bogs dbyung ba la/ rgyas btab pa dang*/ zung du 'jug pa'o/ /dang po bde ba ro mnyam pa ni/ phyag rgya mtshan ldan khrus bya/ lus zung skyed rlung la slabs/ gur gum gyis byug /dngul chu dug bton pa thigs pa gnyis gsum bha gar byug /chang gar ma cung zad 'thung du bcug rang gi pang du tsog pur gnas pa'i pad+ma'i skyil krung gis 'khyud rdo rje pad+mar bcug rig ma rlung 'jam por gnon du bcug /dal bus srub/ thig le rdo rjer son pa na/ 'gron bu'i rgyal po'i sbyor ba dang*/ rang gi 'og sgo sdams steng mnan/ bu mo'i steng rlung mnan 'og rlung gsang bar klod pa'i bde ba bzung zhing ye shes ngos bzung ngo*/ /de nas hūṃ dgur sbyor gyis drangs te/ gsang ba nas yar spags pa tsam mam/ lte bar gtad la/ hring 'dren dang*/ snying kar gtad la uṣ+ṇi ṣa dang*/ mgrin par gtad la hig /ces stag mo skyug tshul dang*/

smin mtshams su gtad la rngub cing seng ge'i ngur sdang dang*/ spyi gtsug tu gtang rlung skor ba gsum gyi rtsa gsum spyi gtsug tu thim par bsam pa ste/ phyi ma gsum dgang 'dren yin no/ /'gram pa spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas bde ba'i shes pa des snang grag la rgyas 'debs pa'o/ /gnyis pa zung du 'jug pa ni/ stong par ro snyoms pa ste/ de la dang po tshig drug dang steng sgo bcad pa ni/ rtsa gsum thig gu lta bu las rdo rje rtse gcig hūṃ gis mtshan pa mda' ltar 'phang ba sogs byed/ 'di skabs su sku mnyes bya'o/ /snang grags la stong pa'i rgyas btab te dbyings su skyol/ gnyis pa dbu mar 'dzud pa ni/ rdor dkyil rdo rje bsdom pa gsang bar brkyang sprug cing lus sgrim mig 'byed 'dzum cung zad spel bsus pa 'gyur bya/ rtsa gsum la waṃ dkar haṃ sngo i dmar ba'i mtshan pa/ rlung mnan pas rtsa gsum 'dus mdor sleb/ 'og rlung sdams/ rdo rje sdams pa kha thur sub/ mig bzlog ste/ hūṃ zhes drangs/ yig ge gsum/ spyi bor drangs yang yi ge rnams yar 'gro mar 'gro bya'o/ /sems rtags lnga yon tan brgyad 'byung ngo*/ /yang de thams cad kyi nyams snang grags rgyas btab/ bdag med ma'i nang khrid rdzogs rim dang*/ de yang zung 'jug tu bya'o/ /bar yig rnying las shes par bya'o/ /grub thob ra hu la'i gdam pa las rgya dang 'brel ba bshad zin to/ /gzhan yang ra hu la'i rlung phyogs gzhan rnams dang*/ su kha'i skor gyi lte ba sprul 'khor gyi rdzogs rim dang*/ bdag med ma'i nang khrid kyi rdzogs rim dang*/ phyis gnyen ston chen po las byung ba'i 'chi med grub pa sogs kyang legs par 'byor na/ gzhan lus kyi rdzogs rim la thogs pa med pa'i mthu thob par 'gyur ro/ /shangs chos kyi man ngag dar yang bde ba lam byed kyis 'di rnams deng sang phal cher la dkon zhing*/ ra hu la'i man ngag gi dpe rnams cung zad mod kyang lag len phyogs mgo tsam yang ma theng ba shas che zhing*/

lhag ma rnams dpe yang cung zad dkon/ ni gu'i gsang lam la lag len cung zad yod mod kyang*/ bsre slad byas pa dang*/ khungs med sbyor ba sogs snang bas/ de dag la phan pa'i phyir yi ge rigs chig chog rgyal po 'di byas pa yin no/ /rab zab lam 'di bshad pas kyang*/ /'gro kun bde chen sku 'grub ste/ /zag med bde ba cher rgyas pa'i/ /mchod sprin rgyun mi 'chad par shog/ //ces shangs pa bka' brgyud kyis man ngag chags lam 'khrid tshul rim pa lnga yod pa chab gcig tu sgrigs pa ste/ thabs lam gser gyi phung po zhes bya ba 'di yang gtsang smyon kun dga' dpal bzang gis bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ bi stā ra ku ru/ zhus dag /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 248 -- PAGE 247 -- PAGE 247 -
